dialogues.speaker: Wuyuan
dialogues.text: Hello! Yes, it really is me! Thanks for being my fan.

dialogues.speaker: Wuyuan
dialogues.text: Come on then! Hand over your copy of Records of Jueyun and I'll sign it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Wuyuan
dialogues.text: Didn't bring it? No worries — I've got a few autographed copies here, I can give you one free of charge!
